mailboxIntro: Emails stored by the outbox transport. In production, configure SMTP; this page is unavailable.
verificationIntro: This page stands in for the provider-hosted verification flow. Choosing an outcome sends an HMAC-signed callback to the same webhook endpoint a real provider uses. It is disabled in production.
paymentIntro: This page stands in for the payment provider's hosted checkout. Choosing an outcome sends an HMAC-signed payment notification to the webhook endpoint. No money moves. It is disabled in production.
sessionInvalid: This simulator session is invalid or expired.
